method: FPL's projected parts turned back into counts at FPL's prices for his FPL position, then priced at each Fantrax slot he is eligible for by the real league's rules (goals, assists, clean sheets, minutes). Bonus dropped. FPL's DefCon and saves replaced by his own real-league DefCon and keeper points per 90 over the gameweeks played so far, each match priced on its own, drawn toward his slot's average as if he had also played 270 minutes at it, times projected minutes. 'conceded' is every deduction (goals conceded, cards, own goals, missed penalties), FPL's own, with goals conceded re-costed where his Fantrax slot charges them and FPL's position did not, or the reverse.
